**OFFICE NOTE**

**To:** All Heads of Departments
**From:** The Registrar
**Subject:** Diwali Holiday Closure

This is to inform all Heads of Departments that the Institute will remain closed on 8 November 2026 in observance of the Diwali holiday.

Consequently, all official work and administrative activities will be suspended on this date. Regular academic classes and institutional operations are scheduled to resume on 9 November 2026.

All HODs are requested to ensure that necessary arrangements are made to secure the premises and address any urgent matters prior to the closure. Please disseminate this information to your respective faculty and staff members to ensure a smooth workflow upon resumption.

Thank you for your cooperation.

**Registrar**

Office of the Dean (Academics)
Circular No. ACAD/2026/117                                             4 October 2026
Subject: Revision of the mid-semester examination timetable
All Heads of Departments are informed that the mid-semester examinations scheduled from 13 October 2026
will now commence on 19 October 2026 owing to the state holiday on 14 October. The revised timetable is
attached. Departments shall display it on their notice boards and inform students through the portal
by 9 October 2026. Invigilation duty rosters already circulated remain valid with dates shifted by
three days. Queries may be addressed to the Examination Section (ext. 2210).
Sd/- Dean (Academics)

Next, they should organize these documents systematically, creating a clear index that allows auditors to locate evidence of academic quality and administrative efficiency quickly. It is also crucial to prepare a concise presentation highlighting recent achievements, ongoing challenges, and strategic plans for the department’s future development. Finally, the convener should brief faculty members on their specific roles during the visit to ensure a coordinated and professional response to any auditor inquiries.

**OFFICE NOTE**

**To:** All Heads of Departments
**From:** The Registrar
**Subject:** Diwali Holiday – 8 November 2026

This is to inform all departments that the Institute will remain closed on 8 November 2026 in observance of the Diwali holiday.

Consequently, all academic and administrative activities are suspended for the day. Regular classes and official duties will resume on 9 November 2026.

Heads of Departments are requested to ensure that necessary security arrangements are put in place for the closure period and to inform their respective staff and students accordingly. Please ensure that all sensitive materials and equipment are secured before leaving the premises on 7 November 2026.

We wish everyone a prosperous and safe Diwali.

**Registrar**
